body:
Claudio: YY requested exact read-only six-GB host list — dependency review only. YY explicitly asked for this list and then asked me to give it to you. **YY has NOT approved removal of this or any prior set. Nothing has been deleted, pruned, moved or untagged. Please review the exact dependencies and present the choices to YY before any deletion.**

Observed 2026-10-15T09:49:42.183331+00:00 to 2026-10-15T09:57:50.549148+00:00. No files, images, containers, cache or settings were changed.

**One exact option totals about 6.083 GB estimated.** It contains 65 explicitly listed unused/unshared cache records, three older standalone backup files, one unused previous Soil Museum image and three closed proof folders. Two backup files are distinct historical restore points without another verified exact copy; their retirement needs your explicit acceptance. The third backup has an independently hash-verified identical copy that stays.

Docker estimates are separate from physical file allocations. Shared image layers are excluded from the image estimate; shared cache records are excluded. Actual Docker space reclaimed can differ. No blanket image/cache prune is approved.

| Review ID | Exact item | Estimated / physical GB | What still depends on it / consequence |
|---|---|---:|---|
| C1–C65 | Exact IDs and per-record bytes in [cache CSV](exact-build-cache-65-records.csv) below | 4.140195 | All InUse=false and Shared=false. No child cache record outside this exact set depends on a selected record. Future builds rebuild these caches; existing images stay. |
| B1 | `/opt/lims/backups/dev_pre_issue155_20261003_132428.db` | 0.563327 | No active/configured/retained-release consumer found. This is a distinct old restore point; another exact copy has NOT been verified. Deleting it retires that historical restore point. |
| B2 | `/opt/lims/backups/dev_pre_issue159_20261003_221538.db` | 0.563327 | No active/configured/retained-release consumer found. This is a distinct old restore point; another exact copy has NOT been verified. Deleting it retires that historical restore point. |
| B3 | `/opt/lims/backups/failed_db_20261004_031055.db` | 0.563327 | Retain /opt/lims/backups/dev_pre_api_dialog218_20261004_031055.db; byte-identical SHA-256 verified. |
| I1 | `soil-museum:prev-20261014-093649` — `sha256:3e90c082c7dad009472e8d911921b4293d6f6fe0c05084737a3b717e75969f96` | 0.245986 estimated unique; 0.839414 logical total | No running/stopped container, exact configuration or retained LIMS release reference found. Retires a previous Soil Museum build. |
| P1 | `/opt/lims/releases/workflow-batch-forward-metadata-cde8c889-20261014T233000Z` | 0.001503 | All 46 file bytes independently matched to published Git blobs; no mount, process-open-file or other release-input reference found. |
| P2 | `/opt/lims/releases/workflow-batch-stopped-copy-cde8c889-20261015T020000Z` | 0.002707 | All 22 file bytes independently matched to published Git blobs; no mount, process-open-file or other release-input reference found. |
| P3 | `/opt/lims/releases/workflow-batch-stopped-copy-cde8c889-20261015T023000Z` | 0.002810 | All 25 file bytes independently matched to published Git blobs; no mount, process-open-file or other release-input reference found. |

**Total: 6,083,182,001 bytes / 6.083 GB estimated.** If only the verified duplicate backup is acceptable, the same set excluding the other two backups is about 4.957 GB, short of 6 GB.

The running production image, current database, latest backup sets and proof folders without another verified evidence copy are excluded from this review list. In particular, the 050000 raw files and 060000 database files are not candidates. No current input, qualified build or retained stopped container is proposed for removal.

The published [complete readable list](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/review-list.md) includes every one of the 65 cache IDs, individual bytes, parent/child links and last use. The [exact JSON](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/exact-review-list.json) and [publication index](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/publication-index.json) retain the complete evidence bindings. Exact sortable lists: [65 cache records](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/exact-build-cache-65-records.csv), [old backup options](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/old-backup-options.csv), [unused image options and dependencies](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/unused-image-options.csv), [three verified proof folders](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/verified-proof-folder-options.csv).

**Backup distinction:** the two issue155/issue159 files retire distinct historical restore points; another exact copy has NOT been verified. They are older standalone backups, not the current DB or latest backup sets. No current configuration, retained release-authority input, open process file or container mount consumer was found in the inspected scope. Their removal still needs YY to accept losing those restore points. The failed_db file is different: its retained dev_pre_api_dialog218 counterpart is byte-identical by stable SHA-256. No backup contents were transferred or opened with SQLite.

**Held image dependencies:** the unused 15.275GB soilfer/lab:2026.10b is selected by the running hub LAB_IMAGE and deployment .env, so it stays. Manual-sync is still referenced by /opt/soilfer-learn/docker-compose.yml:74; temporalio/admin-tools:1.32.0 by /opt/alitt/docker-compose.yml:95. Historical LIMS images and the other previous Museum image remain held by the exact retained release/protection references shown in the image CSV. OCI manifest aliases were resolved: candidate1d has 15 stopped-container consumers and is excluded. No running production image is a removal option.

**Proof evidence:** all 93 actual files across ONLY metadata233000/020000/023000 were freshly stable-hashed and independently matched to published raw Git blobs; the [per-file verified-copy record](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/blob/420919a83fed52ee229caaee32158a0a61eccd59/WP/yy-host-capacity-options-6gb-20261015/proof-copies-verified-elsewhere.json) contains exact commits/paths/hashes. No current mount, process-open-file or selected release-input consumer was found. 050000 raw files, 060000 DB files, all unverified proof folders, current/next inputs, qualified build roots and all stopped containers are excluded. The earlier five-root card is not this list and grants no authority.

Fresh sanitized metadata windows were09:49:42–09:57:50UTC, including all76 containers, OCI image-manifest consumers, cache parent edges, 137 config/service/cron files and selected retained release authority/scripts. This does not prove absence of every external/manual consumer. Reference free space27,415,519,232B is not a fresh capacity gate. Docker cache/image values are accounting estimates, not guaranteed physical deletion deltas. No blanket prune is proposed; eventual exact-ID support and fresh state must be checked only after YY approves an exact set. **This handoff is read-only review, not cleanup authorization, a source PASS, a proof launch or a release gate.**
